title: Viktor Hachmang, poster for Trailer/Min Expo
lede: A riso-printed exhibition poster by the Dutch illustrator Viktor Hachmang: fluorescent pink and dark blue, with coarse halftone dots and overprinted violet.
summary: Riso poster in fluorescent pink and blue with coarse halftone and violet overprint.

source.label: Flickr: Marcel van Schooten, “Poster Trailer/Min Expo”

creator.name: Viktor Hachmang (design), as the Flickr description states

evidence.note: Viewed the 1024 × 576 px Flickr “large” file of a close photograph of one printed copy, owned and photographed by Marcel van Schooten. The image shows a detail, not the whole sheet.

styles.note: Two spot inks, fluorescent pink and blue, with halftone screens and a third color where they overprint.

context: The Flickr description says: “Printed on RISO printer with an awesome design by Viktor Hachmang.” The photo is licensed CC BY 2.0 by the photographer, who is not the designer.
observed: Fluorescent pink and a dark blue are the only inks on cream paper.
A regular pink halftone dot field fills the background. A finer blue screen gives a light gray-blue tint.
Where blue lines and fills cross the pink, the overlap prints a dark violet.
Line drawing and lettering are clean and of even weight. There are no black key lines.
interpretation: A clear example of the two-ink riso poster: the third color is made by overprint, and halftone screens stand in for extra inks.
borrow: Use a pink halftone as a background tint and let a second ink overprint it, instead of adding a third color.

rights.statement: The photograph is CC BY 2.0 by Marcel van Schooten, but the poster design is a third-party work in copyright. Link only.
